about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A Brief Overview
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Irfan, a Frontend Developer based in Indonesia. I have a strong passion for creating web interfaces that not only function seamlessly but also deliver an engaging visual experience.

Over the past few years, I've immersed myself in the JavaScript ecosystem, specializing in React and Tailwind CSS. I continually strive to learn the latest technologies and apply them to solve real-world problems.
